A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Neo4j is a very mature graph database that can handle large datasets, while Orient DB is the fastest graph database, but it is not able to scale well.

Neo4j is a mature and well-established system with a very good support for transactions, OrientDB has an interesting distributed implementation with very fast read operations and DEX is a promising system that has a lot of potential but still lacks some basic features such as transactions.
